name: Ask Me
desc: Questions from agents that couldn't reach you; answer them here.
about: When an agent working for you has a question and gets no reply in its own session within 5 minutes, it leaves the question here through MCP. Answer by tapping a suggestion or typing, and the answer goes straight back to the agent, which may be waiting for it.

intents.phrase: …answer questions my agents left for me
intents.desc: Questions agents couldn't get answered in their own session, with suggested answers as buttons.
